spec.description: Every watch, warning and advisory in effect right now, optionally narrowed. Unnarrowed this is the whole country and runs to a few hundred alerts, so narrow by `area`, `zone` or `point` unless you want all of it.

request.title: GetActiveAlertsRequest
request.description: How to narrow the alerts. Every filter is optional; the array-valued ones are sent as repeated query keys and mean "any of".

area.description: Two-letter state, territory or marine-area codes to narrow to, such as `WA` or `PZ`. Sent as a repeated query key. Left un-enumerated deliberately: the service's own 400 lists only the marine half of what it accepts, and a guessed enum would reject the states.

items.description: One marine region: `AL` Alaska, `AT` Atlantic, `GL` Great Lakes, `GM` Gulf of Mexico, `PA` Pacific, `PI` Pacific Islands.

point.description: A `latitude,longitude` pair; returns the alerts covering that point.

status.description: Alert statuses to include. Lower-case, unlike every other enumerated filter here. Pass `actual` to leave out drills and tests.

event.description: Event names to include, such as `Red Flag Warning`.

response.title: AlertCollection
response.description: The alerts in effect, as a GeoJSON feature collection.

notes: No `pagination` block: this endpoint takes no `limit` and no cursor. It answers with everything matching the filters in one response, which is why the filters matter.

The filter enumerations are not guessed: the service publishes each one in the 400 it answers a bad value with (`Does not have a value in the enumeration [...]`), and these are copied from those replies. That is also how the casing quirk surfaced -- `status` takes `actual`, while `severity`, `urgency` and `certainty` take `Severe`, `Immediate`, `Likely`. A client that lower-cased all four uniformly would 400 on three of them.

`zone` is a plain string. The service constrains it with a regex over every state and zone-type combination (`^(A[KLMNRSZ]|C[AOT]|...)[CZ]\d{3}$`), which is a real constraint but not an enumeration, and not one this spec format can carry.
